title: 1998 remote viewing of the world's future to 2050

tellings.quote: back in 1998 I was tasked with um viewing the future of the US. it wound up I viewed the future of the world uh up through the year 2050

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant trained in remote viewing, a practice of trying to sense distant or hidden things with the mind alone, says that in 1998 he was given the task of viewing the future of the United States. He says the session turned into a view of the whole world's future, up through the year 2050, which if true would suggest the mind can see ahead in time.
